commit.message:
feat(Linter): linter that detects concrete instances (#44625)

This PR implements a linter that flags concrete instances. This is useful for beginners who might write `[Field ℝ]` because they want to use that `ℝ` is a field. There is a built in exception for `Decidable`, since adding redundant `Decidable` hypotheses, such as `DecidableEq True` and `∀ P, Decidable P`, can be desired to avoid instance diamonds.

feat(Linter): linter that detects concrete instances (#44625)

This PR implements a linter that flags concrete instances. This is useful for beginners who might write `[Field ℝ]` because they want to use that `ℝ` is a field. There is a built in exception for `Decidable`, since adding redundant `Decidable` hypotheses, such as `DecidableEq True` and `∀ P, Decidable P`, can be desired to avoid instance diamonds.

refactor(LinearAlgebra/FreeModule/PID): extract lemma from `basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree` (#45038)

The proof of `Module.basisOfFiniteTypeTorsionFree` (a finite torsion free module over a PID is free) contains a construction of a submodule `N` such that `A • M ⊆ N` for some `A ≠ 0`. I extract (and slightly golf) this construction into its own lemma `exists_linearIndepOn_smul_mem_span` because I want to use the same construction elsewhere.

Co-authored-by: pre-commit-ci-lite[bot] <117423508+pre-commit-ci-lite[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

chore: remove unnecessary set_option lines (#45066)

I removed 1311 unnecessary `set_option` line(s) across 512 file(s).

chore: bump dependencies, fix #min_imports test (#45316)

This PR updates Batteries to `7d582b1` and importGraph to `76c79b0`.

In a module file, `#min_imports` now reports at the end of the file, so `#guard_msgs` cannot capture its warning. `MathlibTest/BasicFiles/Init.lean` now reports and clears the request with `logAllMinImports` and `resetMinImports`. This replaces #45219.

🤖

chore: rename `nonzero` to `ne_zero` in theorem names (#44824)

This renames theorems whose `nonzero` stands for a `≠ 0` hypothesis or conclusion to use `ne_zero`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

chore: make `Matrix.*_apply` lemmas protected (#45308)

This is preliminary work for using `IsApply` lemmas instead in #45307 and #45271 for instance.

ci(workflows): make fork PR cache limit explicit (#45223)

Set `cache-mode: read` on the fork PR build's reusable workflow call. This preserves current cache access and makes GitHub reject future write requests from `build_template.yml`.

YAML parsing and `git diff --check` pass.

doc(ClickSuggestions): mention Neovim in `#click_suggestions` docstring (#45304)

This PR expands the docstring of `#click_suggestions` to clarify that it can be used in `Neovim` and how.

feat(Topology/Sheaves): use `abbrev` for `Presheaf`, `IsSheaf`, and `Sheaf` (#34094)

Changing `TopCat.Presheaf`, `TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf`, and `TopCat.Sheaf` from defs to abbrevs.

Co-authored-by: Junyan Xu <junyanxu.math@gmail.com>

chore: update Mathlib dependencies 2026-10-26 (#45219)

This PR updates the Mathlib dependencies.

It is not merged automatically: a maintainer should look at what the new
dependency revisions bring in before sending it to bors.

chore(Algebra): move `LinearMap.proj` and `LinearMap.pi` (#45302)

This is needed for using `LinearMap.proj` in `IsApply` typeclasses to define an abstract `FunLike.eval` as a linear map.

chore(TensorProduct): golf `mul_assoc` of tensor algebras (#45234)

We add an auxiliary lemma for proving the associativity law of bilinear maps, turning an equality in terms of bilinear maps into an equality of linear maps so that we can use `ext`. We then use it to golf the proof of `mul_assoc` of tensor algebras.
